component.name: SoundCraft
component.summary: Record, edit and mix audio and MIDI

description.p: This is a community package of SoundCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the SoundCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.

SoundCraft is an open-source, native digital audio workstation written in Rust that follows the Avid Pro Tools workflow. Record, edit and mix multitrack audio and MIDI in Edit and Mix windows that work the way studio engineers expect.

ul.li: Non-destructive clip editing with fades, playlists, grids and markers
A mixer with inserts, sends, buses, automation and metering
Built-in EQ, dynamics, reverb, delay, modulation and instruments
MIDI piano roll and score editor, video track, surround and object panning
Imports WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3 and MIDI; bounces to disk

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=soundcraft-cli ai.storyteller.soundcraft --help

Plugins: VST3 and CLAP plugins in ~/.vst3 and ~/.clap are visible read-only, as are the org.freedesktop.LinuxAudio.Plugins extensions from Flathub. Plugins built for your distribution link against its libraries, not the Flatpak runtime's, and may fail to load; the Flatpak extensions are built for the runtime.

Permissions: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, sound playback and recording, the Music folder, and the user plugin folders (read-only). Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted.

ul.li: Let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.soundcraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder (command line, recent sessions): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.soundcraft
